verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum with OmniGrip Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Buy it if you want a home robot that can vacuum, mop and also pick up small items. It offers strong cleaning performance and a built‑in arm, but the arm can struggle with some objects.
